rows.old_strong_claim: Every contradiction births dimension or collapse.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 counterexample: existing repair/redaction can resolve a conflict without event-level new axis or collapse.
rows.repaired_claim: Under explicit trigger, if no same-description repair satisfies active constraints while preserving organization, then either extension repair satisfies them or organization fails.
rows.proof_obligation: Exhaustive finite classification of same repair, extension repair, collapse under declared organization predicate.
rows.article_boundary: Say bounded central schema under explicit trigger; forbid universal law wording.

rows.old_strong_claim: The six source operators are globally minimal or unique.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 counterexample: a parameterized rewrite simulates finite input-output transitions.
rows.repaired_claim: The six source operators are locally independent only relative to role-preserving typed effect contracts.
rows.proof_obligation: For each role contract, prove only that role realizes its witness effect; arbitrary rewrite is not role-preserving.
rows.article_boundary: Say role-preserving local independence; forbid global minimal/unique basis wording.

rows.old_strong_claim: K0-K12 is the unique, exhaustive, minimal hierarchy of reality.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 counterexample: alternative strict invariant chains can share endpoint with different count.
rows.repaired_claim: K0-K12 is a reference ladder; declared adjacent invariants make adjacent steps non-collapsible relative to those invariants, without uniqueness/exhaustiveness.
rows.proof_obligation: Prove strict adjacent invariant growth and retain alternative partition as anti-uniqueness guard.
rows.article_boundary: Say reference ladder with declared invariants; forbid unique hierarchy of reality wording.

rows.old_strong_claim: OC law-like wording can be promoted unconditionally.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 counterexample: existing repair breaks unconditional dimension/collapse law.
rows.repaired_claim: OC law-like statements are article-admissible only with trigger, scope, boundary, operator, outcome criterion, and falsifier.
rows.proof_obligation: Check bounded candidate passes required fields and unconditional candidate fails.
rows.article_boundary: Say scoped theorem/candidate law; forbid unconditional law wording.

rows.old_strong_claim: OC core signature alone validates domain projections.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 counterexample: same core signature can have different local validation status.
rows.repaired_claim: The OC core supplies projection obligations; a domain projection is valid only with local observables, operator, falsifier, and evidence package.
rows.proof_obligation: Check fully local projection validates and core-only analogy fails.
rows.article_boundary: Say locally validated projection; forbid validated by core alone wording.

rows.old_strong_claim: Crown stones are established core consequences of the full strong model.
rows.refutation_reason: 025 dependency counterproof: crown-core wording depends on refuted strong claims.
rows.repaired_claim: Crown stones are not core until each has a separate theorem chain from repaired dependencies.
rows.proof_obligation: Reject strong crown-core status while allowing future conditional corollaries after separate proof.
rows.article_boundary: Say future conditional corollaries only; forbid established crown-stone wording.
